description: Assemble the full left Aero Hand in the live preview: attach every finger (thumb plus 4 fingers) from the existing STLs at their correct joints and poses, as separable parts, and use that full-hand model in the reBot arm mount design. Jake: "Attach all the fingers to the Aero Hand. Since we have those STL files, we might as well." Today the Base 10/11 preview (gripper.scad aero_hand(), export_models.py REFS) shows only the palm, left_base_link.STL; the finger link meshes are in third_party/aero_hand/guide/anim41/left_*_link.STL (joint origins in the Aero Hand URDF). Follows voice-3cd78d20.
